In every house, there is a lamp. And behind every lamp... a wall.
Long ago, we learned to give our shadows a shape.
A rabbit. A wolf. A duck.
But some shadows... remember how to move.
Bring your hand toward the light, and it grows. Pull it away... and it shrinks.
Let the wolf howl, and the crows will leave the fence.
Open and close the beak, and the duck will carry you across.
Eight small scenes. One paper theatre. And a moon, waiting to be woken.
